### TryResolve(LoadedRecipe, List&lt;LoadedIngredient&gt;) { #m-tryresolve-nfty-core-formats-loadedrecipe-system-colle-5924c9 }

```csharp
public static bool TryResolve(LoadedRecipe recipe, out List<LoadedIngredient> layers);
```

Resolves a recipe's layerOrder to its ingredients, in order. Never throws: a transiently invalid book (a duplicate ingredient id, or a layerOrder entry naming a removed ingredient) is a normal state for live callers, not a crash. Ids resolve duplicate-tolerantly (last one wins, as [`RecipeLayers.ById()`](Nfty.Core.Formats.RecipeLayers.md#m-byid-nfty-core-formats-loadedrecipe)), and an entry with no ingredient fails the whole recipe back as "unresolved". Deciding what makes a book legal is the validator's job.

**Parameters**

- `recipe` (`LoadedRecipe`) - The recipe.
- `layers` (`List<LoadedIngredient>`) - The ingredients in layer order when this returns true; otherwise empty.

**Returns.** Whether every layerOrder entry named an ingredient.
